Alex — thanks for the clear success criteria, that helps a lot. High level recap and recommended plan below. I copied Dylan (solutions engineer) to confirm technical details and Dev (dev_patel) who can help with VPC onboarding if you choose that path.

Recap (from our call):
- Goal: 4-week POC to validate latency and unit cost for beam-ranking & multi-turn prompts (~512 tokens typical)
- Success criteria: 95p latency < 350ms; token cost <= $0.0008/token

Recommended trial options (pros/cons):
- Hosted (Redwood API): fastest to stand up (1-2 business days). Lower setup friction; good for initial functional validation. No VPC network isolation — data flows through our hosted control plane.
- Dedicated sandbox (reserved pool in our infra): best for predictable throughput and capacity isolation. Setup ~3-5 business days. Supports conservative performance SLOs and burst capacity.
- VPC trial (private deployment): required if InfoSec mandates tenant-isolated network + customer-managed VPC peering. Setup ~1-2 weeks (depends on firewall rules and procurement of static IPs). Good for SOC2/audit-sensitive workloads.

Proposed POC plan & timeline (target start week of Sep 13):
- Sep 10: finalize trial environment decision + sign trial agreement (DocuSign link below)
- Sep 13: environment provisioning starts (hosted: Sep 13, dedicated: Sep 13-15, VPC: Sep 13-20)
- Sep 14-17: baseline tests (synthetic load, cold cache)
- Sep 20-24: production-like tests (sample traffic, KV cache warming)
- Sep 27: final report and decision meeting

Owners:
- FinTechCo: Alex (eval lead), Samira (security/procurement)
- Redwood: Marissa (POC owner & PM), Dylan (SRE/benchmarking), Dev (VPC onboarding / infra)

Next steps I need from you:
1) Confirm preferred environment (hosted | dedicated | VPC)
2) Sign the trial agreement: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-POC-TRIAL
3) Share the list of test prompts + a representative token sample by Sep 8

I'll attach a short MOP (method of procedure) and SOC2 evidence request to help InfoSec.

Thanks — I can be flexible on the timeline if procurement needs extra time.

Best,
Marissa

Alex / team — quick technical notes from my side: 

- For the latency target (95p < 350ms) we need to confirm the following sample characteristics: typical sequence length distribution (you mentioned 512 tokens median), average batch size during evaluation, and whether you will use streaming or non-streaming responses.
- Hosted setup: we'll provision an API key and a dedicated rate-limited route for your account. We can enable prefix caching for repeated prompts. Good for quick functional check.
- Dedicated sandbox: we will reserve a GPU pool and configure autoscaling triggers. This is the best path to measure steady-state latency under load.
- VPC trial: we'll need a security contact for firewall rule coordination and the CIDR ranges from FinTechCo. Dev, can you confirm the static IPs we use for peering and share the network-requirements.xlsx I mentioned.

I attached the SOC2 evidence request we typically share; Samira — happy to run a short security Q&A call if helpful.

- Dylan

- For VPC peering we require two static egress IPs (listed in the attached network-requirements.xlsx).

- If you prefer minimal friction, hosted trial avoids network changes — exceptions only for strict audit environments.
